passage: After reviewing dozens of applications, the selection committee chose a marine biologist to lead its new ocean research program. The scientist ______ the committee selected will begin work in January.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: In the clause "the committee selected ___," the pronoun is the object of "selected."
Test it: "the committee selected her" (an object form), so use "whom."
"Who" is a subject form, "whose" shows possession, and "which" doesn't refer to people.
key: Use whom where him or her would fit; use who where he or she would fit.
